ai.title: o1 reverted to o1-preview
ai.summary: o1 model constant reverted to o1-preview. OpenRouter lacks access to o1-2024-12-17. Planning module imports updated to openai-api. Common constants reflect change.

eli5.text: The assistant switched back to using an earlier preview version of its model after discovering that the newer version wasn't available through the routing system it relies on. This affects any request that uses that specific model and will use the preview version moving forward. If you checked the settings today, you'd see the model set to o1-preview instead of the newer one.

ai.title: main-prompt.ts plancomplexchange threshold raised
ai.summary: System prompt instruction for pro cost mode changed from 'complex' to 'very complex' requests. Added explicit guidance to use plan_complex_change sparingly. This adjustment discourages unnecessary planning tool invocation while using o1-preview model.

eli5.text: The assistant will now only create a step-by-step plan for requests that are genuinely very complex, like projects that require changing many parts of a software system at once. Previously, it would do this planning step for any request that seemed even moderately complex. If you give the assistant a complicated multi-file task, you will still get a plan, but simpler multi-part requests that don't require touching many files will no longer trigger that planning step, making the conversation faster and more direct for most users on the Pro plan.
